title: A memory inspector
hints: `static_cast<const unsigned char*>(data)` turns the `const void*` into something you can index byte by byte. Build each line in three parts: address, hex columns, text column.
Write a small helper that appends a number as a fixed count of hex digits, taking 4 bits at a time from the top: `(value >> (4 * i)) & 0xF`.
requirements: The dump format matches exactly, including the gap after the eighth byte and the padding of the last line.
Non-printable bytes show as `.` in the text column.
Any object can be dumped through `const void*`.
Numbers are read little-endian, and signed reads give negative numbers.
stretch: Add a `diffDump(before, after, size)` that prints only the lines where something changed and marks the changed bytes, the way a memory viewer highlights values that changed since the last step.
